scripts.email:build: mkdir -p emails/dist && mjml emails/*.mjml -o emails/dist --config.minify true
scripts.pages:build: npm run email:build && cp emails/dist/main.html emails/dist/index.html && touch emails/dist/.nojekyll
scripts.email:dev: npm run email:build && concurrently -k -n mjml,server -c magenta,cyan "npm:email:watch" "npm:email:serve"
